$comment: Maps a research request's free-text objective onto discovery capability tags and the driver-library input format. Data-driven so the discovery vocabulary can grow (or move to another domain) without code changes. Consumed by StateMachine._discovery_query.
$comment_capabilities_requiring_a_calcul: Capabilities whose answer comes from an atomistic CALCULATION, so a plan claiming one without a calculator cannot produce it. A NaCl2 heat-of-formation run planned as Pymatgen with calculator=null reached EXECUTE and died on 'No module named matgl' after codegen invented an engine to fill the gap (Slurm job 2633871). property_prediction is deliberately absent: a fingerprint, a descriptor or a database lookup answers it with libraries alone, which is the whole point of a library-only plan.
